title: Why the right chunk can still miss the answer
hook: Policy PDF mein likha hai refund tees din tak milta hai. Lekin sale items pe refund milta hai kya? Dekho AI itna confident hoke bhi galat kaise bol sakta hai.
learningObjective: Debug a missing condition by inspecting retrieved evidence

scenes.narration: Policy PDF mein likha hai refund tees din tak milta hai. Lekin sale items pe refund milta hai kya? Dekho AI itna confident hoke bhi galat kaise bol sakta hai.
scenes.onScreenText: Can a sale item be refunded?
scenes.technicalKeyPoint: Can a sale item be refunded?

scenes.narration: Document ki do lines dekho. Pehli kehti hai refund tees din tak. Doosri kehti hai sale items final hain. Index banate waqt ye lines do alag chunks mein chali gayin. Chunk matlab document ka chhota hissa.

visualProps.code:
[chunk A]
Refunds within 30 days.

[chunk B]
Sale items are final.
visualProps.explanationCallout: The exception lives in the next chunk.

scenes.narration: Ab sawaal aaya. Search system relevant chunks rank karta hai. Maan lo top teen mein refund wali line aayi, sale ki exception nahi aayi. Model ko jo context mila usmein aadha rule tha. Galti answer likhne se pehle ho chuki thi.

visualProps.title: Which chunks reached the model?
visualProps.result: Exception B is missing from the context.

scenes.narration: Fix kaise test karein? Policy aur uski exception ko ek hi section mein rakho. Ya matched chunk ka agla hissa bhi lao. Wahi sawaal dobara chalao. Ab evidence mein dono lines hain, toh sale item ka answer hai no.

visualProps.title: Keep the rule with its exception

scenes.narration: RAG mein pehle search se evidence aata hai, phir model usse answer likhta hai. Galat jawab mile toh retrieved text kholo. Zaroori line gayab hai? Chunk boundary badlo aur wahi sawaal phir test karo.

visualProps.headline: Check what the model actually saw
takeaways: Keep the condition with its rule

sourceBrief.claim: The retrieved passages become context for generation. An omitted exception can lead to an incorrect answer. Chunk size and overlap should be tested against representative questions.
